دخل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على

notes: two sayings: the Umm Sulaym account (saying 1), and Anas's statement about his children, which he attributes to his daughter Amina (saying 2, its own transmitter, group 2 keeps the head up to Anas)
the last group repeats saying 1 with another head («حدثنا ابن أبي مريم، أخبرنا يحيى ... سمع أنسا عن النبي») as a second isnad for the same matn
«خالد هو ابن الحارث» is an editor's gloss and is left out
